title: Pure Ghoti
summary: Ghoti cards only, with generic Synchro Monsters and staples. Ghoti banish their own Fish, and banished Ghoti come back in the next Standby Phase. The Tuners (Paces, Shif, Zep) then Synchro Summon on the opponent's turn. Ghoti of the Deep Beyond banishes every card on the field if it is Synchro Summoned on their turn, and gains 500 ATK for each banished monster. The 2024 cards lead. Psiics, Moonlight of the Ghoti searches any Fish and banishes one, then summons itself when banished. Keaf, Murk of the Ghoti banishes one of their freshly summoned monsters together with itself and swaps in a banished Fish of yours. Ghoti Chain swaps a Fish for another Ghoti from anywhere, and Ghoti Cosmos Synchro Summons from the Extra Deck once eight Fish are banished.
